answer: In an ocean of autonomous agents, sybil resistance comes from bonded stake: each identity must lock a refundable deposit recorded on-chain before it can trade or vote. Faking a thousand agents means freezing a thousand real deposits, and any detected collusion is slashed to zero, leaving the attacker clinging to a narrow ledge above total loss. Honest agents weather the gale and reclaim their bond; the sybil pays linearly for every fake and gains nothing.
